label: Just everyday content
summary: Consistent routine messaging and brand voice
Balanced informational prose without artificial hype

rules.title: Keep Routine Communications Focused & Balanced
rules.description: Routine daily communications should avoid artificial dramatic urgency or clickbait phrasing.
rules.do_example: Here are three quick tips to get more from your account this week.
rules.dont_example: You won't believe what happened in our earth-shattering daily update!
